intro: Colombia has about 53 million people, the third most in Latin America.

chapters.title: People
text: Most Colombians are of mixed European and Indigenous descent; there are large Afro-Colombian communities on the coasts and over 100 Indigenous peoples. Spanish is the official language, and most people are Catholic.
Colombia has taken in nearly three million Venezuelan migrants.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Bogotá sits at 2,640 m. Medellín, once violent, is known for its cable cars and innovation.
